responses.text: The webhook signing secret was rotated at 2026-10-21T08:12:00Z and the receiver still checks the old one, so since 08:15 every delivery gets 401 signature_mismatch [3]. 14 deliveries used all 8 attempts over about 44 hours and failed, and 17 are still pending, which keeps their runs in started [1]. Fix: put the new secret in the receiver, redeliver the failed deliveries (owner or admin) and resync the rules.
